fields.label: Surface
fields.description: Where the error was raised: spa_chat / desk_chat / onboarding / account / pwa / unknown. Display-only.

fields.label: Route
fields.description: The UI route/path (query string stripped) the user was on. Never trusted for a decision.

fields.label: Error Code
fields.description: Classified code from the existing taxonomy (unreachable / timeout / provider / PermissionDeniedError / ...).

fields.label: Error Class
fields.description: The JS error name / constructor (TypeError, ApiError, ...).

fields.label: Message
fields.description: Scrubbed, bounded to 500 chars. PII / ERP values are redacted before this is stored.

fields.label: User
fields.description: The reporting session user (set server-side, never from the client).

fields.label: Conversation
fields.description: Jarvis Conversation id when the error happened inside a chat, else empty.

fields.label: Run ID
fields.description: The chat run id for a turn failure, used to dedupe against the backend view of the same failure.

fields.label: Fingerprint
fields.description: Stable dedupe key (code + class + normalized message + surface). Unpushed rows with the same fingerprint are folded into one with a count.

fields.label: Count
fields.description: How many times this fingerprint has occurred in the current (not-yet-pushed) window.

fields.label: Pushed
fields.description: 1 once forwarded to the admin control plane. Pushed rows are pruned by the daily job.
